status: pre-registered BEFORE any battery, start check or tracking statistic on a BAM body
disclosed_development_runs: 2 s stand + 3 s walk at vx 0.3 on the primary body and on 'cpu'/no-lag (smoke: no NaN, no fall; it covered ~0.3 m from standing in 3 s)
timing probe: one control step on the BAM body ~2x the XML body at load ~17
parity: 14 s scripted rollout of the 'cpu'/no-lag body (r8_bam_parity.py)
question: Does replacing M0's XML position actuators with the BAM M6 XL330 model velstand was trained with bring command tracking within the plan's gate?

primary_body.label: allcollisions_bam_jvlag1
primary_body.meaning: infer_policy.py's numeric BAM defaults (kp_fw 200, vin 7.4 V, sag gain 0.1 V/Nm, vin floor 6 V, no current limiter, force range +-vin*kt/R = 0.963 Nm) + training's friction semantics (bam.mjlab: friction rows matched by DOF, quadratic term without sign gate) + training's actuator delay (BamActuatorCfg delay_min/max_lag 3-6, read as 5 ms physics steps per bam's docs, one lag per episode drawn at reset) + training's 1-control-step joint-velocity observation lag (jv_lag 1, as M0). Scene allcollisions (velstand's training robot, no backlash), no observation noise, as M0.

comparison.xml: the same frozen body re-run through this wrapper (gate_xml.json); expected identical to M0 except wall time

battery: m0_gate.main(body) unchanged, seeds as M0: 16 pad trials (1.5 m, 8 directions x 2 start headings, oracle go-to controller), 20 x 60 s scripted runs at M0's chosen bounds (vx 0.2-0.4, back -0.3, turn in place +-0.5-0.6, forward+turn), 20 x 60 s at training bounds (vx 0.05-0.4, back -0.4, vy +-0.1-0.3, wz +-0.05-1.0), 96 push trials. Steady state = segment mean after the first 1.5 s.

gate.forward: median of achieved/commanded vx over the chosen-bounds 'fwd' segments in [0.75, 1.25]
gate.turn: median of achieved/commanded wz over all chosen-bounds segments with a wz command (turn in place + forward-and-turn, m0_gate's tracking 'wz') in [0.75, 1.25]
gate.straight_yaw_drift: |median achieved wz| over the chosen-bounds 'fwd' segments (wz command 0, vx 0.2-0.4) < 0.05 rad/s
gate.falls: 0 falls (trunk tilt > 45 deg) over the 16 pad trials + 20 chosen-bounds runs + 20 training-bounds runs; push trials excluded (a push-recovery probe that knocks the duck over by design, reported separately)
gate.pass: all four, on the primary body

secondary_reported_not_gating: turn in place and turn while walking separately
lateral response (training-bounds 'lat' segments: median achieved/commanded vy; and start checks)

start_checks.definition: 6 s segment, steady state = mean over the last 4.5 s on the commanded axis; 'started' = |steady| >= 0.05 m/s or rad/s (the M0 review's criterion); 4 standing states (straight after reset, after 3 s standing, after walking then 3 s standing, after 3 s standing with head yaw 0.8) + after 3 s walking at 0.3
start_checks.threshold: none: measured (Pollen: small commands stand still by design; a dead zone may remain)

bam_infer.label: allcollisions_bam-semcpu-lag0-lagmax0_jvlag1
bam_infer.why: infer_policy.py's CPU BAM path exactly: 'cpu' friction semantics (bam.mujoco.MujocoController, incl. its joint-id friction-row matching and the sign-gated quadratic term) and no actuator delay (infer_policy's default). This is the configuration with bit-exact parity evidence.

bam_cpu.label: allcollisions_bam-semcpu_jvlag1
bam_cpu.why: primary with 'cpu' friction semantics (isolates that switch)

bam_lag4.label: allcollisions_bam-lag4-lagmax4_jvlag1
bam_lag4.why: primary with a fixed 4-physics-step (20 ms) lag = M0's lag (isolates the actuator physics vs M0)

bam_resample.label: allcollisions_bam-resampleTrue_jvlag1
bam_resample.why: primary with the lag re-drawn every physics step (the other reading of mjlab's delay defaults)

bam_limiter.label: allcollisions_bam-imax1.75_jvlag1
bam_limiter.why: primary + firmware current limiter 1.75 A (bam.mjlab keeps XL330Actuator's max_current=1.75 at commit 62bd8ce; infer_policy sets None, stating training ran without it)

bam_vin65.label: allcollisions_bam-vin6.5-fvin8.2_jvlag1
bam_vin65.why: training's lowest battery voltage 6.5 V (force range at 8.2 V as in training's edit_spec)

bam_vin82.label: allcollisions_bam-vin8.2-fvin8.2_jvlag1
bam_vin82.why: training's highest battery voltage 8.2 V (force range at 8.2 V)

bam_train.label: allcollisions_bam-imax1.75-fvin8.2-resampleTrue_jvlag1
bam_train.why: most training-like single setting: limiter on, force range at 8.2 V, lag re-drawn per physics step (vin 7.4 ~ DR mean 7.35, sag gain 0.1 = DR mean)

decision_rule: The verdict is the primary body's. Variants are reported side by side; a variant that passes where the primary fails (or the reverse) is reported, never substituted for the primary.

pre_registered_expectations.source: vendor/microduck_rl/docs/velstand_policy.md: Pollen's own v8 evaluation in mjlab + BAM + backlash (NOT our simulator)
pre_registered_expectations.forward: Pollen measured vx 0.4 -> 0.17 achieved (0.43x, the same as the walk teacher alpha_walking), M0 measured 0.44x. Prediction: forward ratio stays ~0.4-0.5 and the forward criterion FAILS for a policy reason (the policy under-tracks vx in its own training simulator), not an actuator one.
pre_registered_expectations.turn: Pollen: in place +-0.6 -> +0.52/-0.57, +-1.0 -> +0.97/-0.87; walking 0.2 m/s with +-0.6 -> +0.54/-0.56. Prediction: if the port reproduces training, the turn ratio moves from M0's 1.39 to ~0.85-1.0 (criterion passes).
pre_registered_expectations.drift: Pollen: straight-walk drift -0.02/+0.03/+0.08 rad/s at 0.2/0.3/0.4 m/s. Prediction: |median| < 0.05 (passes, marginal at 0.4 m/s); M0 was +0.22.
pre_registered_expectations.dead_zone: Pollen: in place +-0.3 -> +0.08/-0.22, 'standing still WAS the reward optimum at 0.3'. Prediction: wz 0.3 in place starts weakly or not at all; vx 0.1 likely does not start.
pre_registered_expectations.overall: Predicted verdict: FAIL on the forward criterion alone, with turn and drift brought into range by BAM.

steps_per_s: single process, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, plain scene, vx 0.3, 2,000 control steps after 100 warm-up, 3 interleaved XML/BAM repeats, median; load average recorded
